# Seat 1 preregistration — N-Nest × Q-PRISM real-source watcher adapter

Date: 2026-10-15. This protocol was committed **before** Seat 1 implementation and its CI outputs. It fulfills the Seat 1 integrator assignment in [Issue #29](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/issues/29) without touching coordinator PR #28 or source-contract draft PR #30.

## Sources frozen BEFORE experiment
- N-Nest `JesseBrown1980/N-Nest-Prime-INFINITE-SELF-REFLECT-AGENTS-NESTED` at commit `307903651f56e8a28ef98ca36aef22ee8cda935c`. Verify Git blob SHA-1 for native depth-3 and prime-depth-7 watcher scripts exactly.
- Q-PRISM `JesseBrown1980/Q-PRISM-human-organoid-neural-stream-as-a-high-dimensional-control` at commit `b4a21a25381d6920b7aab92c94c3c3e1420fc9e4`. Verify Git blob SHA-1 for `harness.py`, `sources.py`, `physics.py`, `behcs.py`, 1024-glyph data and claim-gate docs. Git blob SHA-1 is different from SHA-256 of a scientific output.
- A `git checkout` of either moving `main` is insufficient; exact pinned commits and blob identities are required.

## Integration conditions and measurements

1. Run **original upstream files**, not a renamed clone of their design: `node nest-depth3-verify.cjs`, `node nest-depthN-prime-verify.cjs`. Collect each generated dated HBP and verify its native SHA-256 sidecar. The source scripts use **synthetic PID labels**; they do not spawn a live agent farm. Confirm clean apex, wrong-leaf hold at path `R.1.2.0`, and caught faults at every prime depth 1..7.
2. On the **actual pinned** Q-PRISM Python package, run upstream `tests/test_harness_null.py` with Python dependencies installed. Explicitly invoke its `RandomSource`, `OptimizerSource`, `PrismSource`, `NeuralStream`, `denormalize`, `physics.observe`, `behcs.schedule_id`, plus three-arm `harness.compare` at coupling 0 and 0.9. Freeze `base_seed=2000`, `budget=60`, `repeats=25` for the statistical comparison. Preserve *actual* p-values and scores, not a demanded made-up numeric value. Null must not report significant prism win. Positive coupling is a **synthetic injected oracle**, not neural/physical data.
3. Construct a JSON Q-PRISM proposal that includes exact source SHA pins, input SHA-256, seed, bounded schedule, BEHCS selector, objective values and synthetic coupling. A **separate Python watcher process** imports the same pinned upstream code independently, recomputes the schedule score and selector from the input, and compares values *without trusting the producer's reported score/selector*. The synthetic apparatus model is not a physical detector.
4. Propagate the leaf watcher result up constructed depth-3 and depth-7 N-Nest-compatible parent gates. `parent_green = own_gate AND all_child_green`; report exact failing path. The adapter is distinct from the original N-Nest standalone scripts, so do **not** claim the upstream source natively accepts external leaf evidence or authenticates physical identity.
5. Fail-closed negatives: forged score, altered selector, changed source commit, wrong input SHA, missing consent, changed canonical leaf payload, compromised watcher result, and at least one failed depth-3 or depth-7 ancestor. A tampered leaf or child must not yield a green apex. A score with perfectly self-consistent forged physical provenance may be **mathematically unprovable** without an external authenticated sensor; do not claim that counterexample was prevented.
6. Produce a deterministic receipt with key names `version,source_repo,source_commit,input_sha256,selector,control_arm,seed,scores,watcher_pid,reported,recomputed,parents,verdict`, source blob pins, run ID, source SHA, native HBP checksums, all test/held counts. Seal HBP + JSON + SHA-256 sidecars per CI run. No secret, token, machine serial, private user data, or real neural input may appear.
7. A green local result is **Seat 1 producer verification**, not a third-party independently implemented replay. Seat 3 peer review remains mandatory before any full-integrated acceptance.

## Release boundaries
Computational, simulated, additive publication only. This work does not demonstrate biological signal detection, actual matter-wave apparatus control, unbounded agents, verified independent hardware, quantum/gravity/FTL effects or free compression. Do not restart Seat 2/3/4 current tests, rewrite sealed stones, merge draft PR #30 automatically, issue the physical three-host challenge, or publish to Hugging Face without verified repository write authorization.
